title.narrative: Jakarta ICMPS 2022 PERKUMPULAN SUARA KITA JAKARTA VDI128

description.narrative: The ID Card and Social Protection for Transgender Women in Indonesia implemented by Suara Kita Foundation aims to contribute to increase the ability of transgender women focal points to work with and campaign for transgender people. The objectives of the grant is to support training for focal points in Indonesia who are assisting transgender persons to access to social protections including an Indonesian ID card. The key activities include training and assisting transgender women focal points in targeted districts/cities to be able to assist transgender women to obtain their population and administration documents, receive social protection, including government healthcare insurance and enable transgender women to strengthen outreach with local governments in Jakarta, West Java, and Banten. Trainings and workshops, including Focus Group Discussions will be conducted in hybrid (combination of online and in-person) to increase knowledge and skills of focal points.
